import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170, 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    valid = df.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    return valid.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
